title: a binary module this runtime cannot load, diagnosed rather than loaded silently

native_module.name: KrWrongAbi
native_module.note: A binary module built against another runtime ABI cannot be produced from a fixture, so what this case ships is an assembly file this runtime refuses to load. What it proves is the diagnosis: the profile records that the import failed, the module is absent from the loaded list, and the integration is still qualified afterwards.
